visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a modern, well-lit living room where a man in a black t-shirt and a woman in a white cardigan are seated on a spacious grey sofa. The man holds a black handheld microphone and sings with exaggerated emotional expressions, while the woman looks down at her smartphone with a visible look of confusion and skepticism. The background features a clean kitchen area and indoor plants, creating a domestic setting. (2) As the man continues his melodramatic singing performance, the woman looks up from her device, her facial expression shifting from confusion to annoyance. She begins to sing back at him, using theatrical hand gestures and intense eye contact to question him, mirroring his performance style. (3) The man leans towards the woman while sustaining a final high note, his eyes closed in a mock-serious performance. The woman eventually sighs and looks away. (4) In the sudden final shot, the woman swings a large black designer bag with significant force, striking the man on the head just as he finishes his line, causing him to duck and move out of the frame.
